extracted.name: Gin and Tonic
extracted.description: A refreshing gin and tonic with plenty of ice; lime juice adds a bright and zesty flavor. Nothing says summer quite like a good ol' gin and tonic!
instruction_lines: Place ice cubes in a tall, narrow glass. Pour gin over ice; add tonic water and lime juice. Stir well with a long-necked spoon. Garnish with lime wedge.
